webshop_bad_token: The stored token is not in the expected form — check it was pasted whole, without a space.
webshop_bad_url: The stored address is not a web address (it must start with http:// or https://).
webshop_no_token: No device token is stored on this tablet.
webshop_no_url: No back-office address is stored on this tablet.
webshop_open_blank: Frame staying blank? Open the back office in a tab
webshop_revoked: This tablet's token was revoked from the back office. No data is shown.
webshop_revoked_fix: Ask the franchisee for a new token, then enter it in the settings.
webshop_revoked_title: This tablet is no longer authorised
webshop_unchecked: Token unverified: the webshop is unreachable. The frame below may stay empty until the network is back.
webshop_url_hint: Leave empty to use the address configured on the server.
webshop_where: Both settings are in the back office, under Settings › Kitchen tablet.
ws_closed: Your franchisee can open it from the back office, under Settings › Kitchen tablet.
ws_closed_title: This screen is not open to this tablet
ws_error: The order could not be updated.
ws_net_body: This is a network problem, not an absence of orders. Try again in a moment.
ws_net_down: The webshop is unreachable. What you see is not up to date — it's the network, not the shop.
ws_no_order_hint: Nothing to prepare right now. New orders will appear here.
ws_not_served: Orders are not served by the webshop yet.
ws_not_served_stock: Stock is not served by the webshop yet.
ws_subtitle: Orders, stock and indicators for the shop
